mapper.sql: id, amount_paid, amount_payable, remarks, purchase_date, purchase_number, state, supplier_id, user_id
mapper.select: select max(purchase_number) as purchaseNumber from t_purchase_list where trunc(purchase_date) = trunc(sysdate)

select pl.purchase_number as "number",pl.purchase_date as "date",s.name as "name",plg.code as "code",plg.name as "goodsName",plg.model as "model", gt.name as "typeName",plg.price as "price",plg.num as "num",plg.unit as "unitName",plg.total as "total" from t_purchase_list pl left join t_supplier s on pl.supplier_id=s.id left join t_purchase_list_goods plg on pl.id=plg.purchase_list_id left join t_goods_type gt on plg.type_id=gt.id
and plg.name like '%${purchaseListQuery.goodsName}%'
and pl.state=#{purchaseListQuery.state}
and pl.purchase_date >= to_date(#{purchaseListQuery.startDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and pl.purchase_date < to_date(#{purchaseListQuery.endDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')+1
and plg.type_id in (select id from t_goods_type where id=#{purchaseListQuery.typeId} or p_id=#{purchaseListQuery.typeId})
